newsitem.title: USA: Banta sees comparable earnings for 2d half.
newsitem.headline: Banta sees comparable earnings for 2d half.

text.p: Banta Corp said Tuesday it expects earnings for the second half of 1996 to be comparable to those achieved during the same year-ago period.

"While aggressive pricing competition will remain until the balance between industry capacity and demand begins to stabilize, the printing industry should immediately benefit from lower paper prices," said Chairman Donald Belcher in a statement.
Belcher added that he expects the lower prices to "provide a foundation for a return to more normal market conditions."

Earlier, the printing and digital imaging company posted third quarter earnings of $15.3 million or $0.49 per share compared with $15.5 million or $0.51 per share. Sales advanced six percent to $265 million.
The third quarter was affected by higher-than-normal catalog equipment startup expenses, Belcher said.

"While demand for assembly and distribution services for computer software and hardware markets was weak early in the quarter, Banta reports that momentum began building in September with promising activity involving key customers and new prospects in both the U.S. and Europe," Belcher added.
